The implementer cannot execute this without guessing the report format.

Task T012 is marked [X] but contains the comment 'ATOMIZE: requested'. While the atomizer will split this, the current task description is too coarse ('Execute the pipeline on a small sample...') to be executed as a single atomic unit without ambiguity on sample size or success criteria.
